title: 聚合与分组
theory:
## 聚合函数与 GROUP BY

聚合函数对一组值进行计算，返回单个值。

### 常用聚合函数
`COUNT()`, `SUM()`, `AVG()`, `MIN()`, `MAX()`

### GROUP BY + HAVING
`GROUP BY` 分组聚合，`HAVING` 过滤分组结果（类似 WHERE 但用于聚合后）。

### ⚠️ 注意
SELECT 中的非聚合列必须出现在 GROUP BY 中。
learningObjectives: 掌握 GROUP BY 分组
使用 HAVING 过滤分组

examples.label: 统计订单总数
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

examples.label: 每用户订单金额
examples.sql: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY total DESC;

examples.label: HAVING 过滤
examples.sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

examples.label: 平均订单金额
examples.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

initialSQL: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY total DESC;
